findings.claim: The foreman role sets effort: "medium" which is never used, since projectClaude emits no thinking/effort field. Dead configuration that suggests an effect it does not have.

The skill-existence test treats every single-word kebab backticked token in the body as a skill, with only `success` exempted. Any future backticked lowercase word (e.g. a status or a flag-free word) in the body fails the test spuriously; conversely, skills named only in non-backtick prose (closure-feedback) are unchecked. Brittle coupling of the test to body formatting.

The body tells the foreman to read memorycard via mem_search/mem_get, and the foreman holds Edit and Write plus Bash with only an instruction-level limit to the feature document. The description says 'writes only the feature document' but nothing enforces it; the tool list grants full write ability, so the claim in the agent description is unenforced.

The line-count test and banned-word test (e.g. "consent", "Engram") pin incidental body wording; the 35-55 line range makes unrelated body edits fail. Also the Never section's line 'gentle-ai review' is fine but the banned list is arbitrary.

evidence: Read the full diff; agentgen.go builds the foreman after the eight roles and only when models table read succeeds, matching the tests' expected ordering and missing-source message.
